title: Square-function estimates from type IV superorthogonality
abstract: Proves the type IV superorthogonality square-function estimate for finite and countable index sets, including the pointwise combinatorial estimate and unconditional convergence in L^(2r).

informal.Superorthogonal.sqfct_estimate_of_type_i: For an integer r >= 1, a countable type IV superorthogonal family in L^(2r), with almost-everywhere summable squared norms and square function in L^(2r), converges unconditionally in L^(2r) and satisfies the square-function bound with constant C(r).
